summary: Cameco Corp filed a Form 6-K with a press release providing an operational update on flooding impacts in northern Saskatchewan. The filing reports that the collapse of the Smoothstone River Bridge has disrupted supply routes to the McArthur River and Key Lake sites, leading to a temporary halt of production activities at Key Lake mill and reduced activity at McArthur River mine. No specific financial terms, transaction details, board recommendations, or structural mechanics are included. The filing is an operational update with no special-situation classification.
